entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: A gigantic siege demon, once a human battlemage, who served Ramses Overdark; destroyed by Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: Master of Orca and Jorgan Hage, enemy of Tetsuo Umezawa.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Overdark's nemesis who beat Orca back and finally destroyed her lair and her.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: Leader who rallied the Edemi Islands against the Empire of Madara.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Overdark's other minion who murdered General Marhault Elsdragon.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General of the kentsu, murdered by Jorgan Hage.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War between the Empire of Madara and the rebelling Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Empire of Madara
entities.description: The empire the Edemi Islands rebelled against.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Rebellious islands attacked by Orca and the kentsu.

entities.name: Kentsu
entities.description: Force that attacked the Edemis, led by General Marhault Elsdragon.

events.summary: Overdark sends Orca to terrorize the Edemi coasts under Tetsuo's banner; Tetsuo survives and beats her back to her lair, ending the siege.
events.quote: Tetsuo not only survived but beat Orca back to her lair, ending her siege

events.summary: Overdark sets Orca against an Akron Legionnaire and she wins, then turns on the kentsu as a diversion so Jorgan Hage can murder General Elsdragon.
events.quote: Orca was victorious but immediately turned on the kentsu

events.summary: Tetsuo chases Orca to her lair and fills the cave with magma, destroying her.
events.quote: he filled the cave with magma, destroying it and ending Orca's existence as well

relations.quote: Lady Orca was a mysterious and very powerful minion of Ramses Overdark
hoped the rebels would hold Tetsuo, his nemesis, responsible
he filled the cave with magma, destroying it and ending Orca's existence as well
